skill.name: lotar-task-tracking
skill.description: Use this to create and maintain LoTaR tasks for work tracking, with minimal friction and consistent updates.
skill.body:
## Quick start

- List tasks:
  - `lotar list`

- Create a task:
  - `lotar add "<title>" --priority=HIGH --type=feature`

- Update status:
  - `lotar status <ID> in_progress`

- Add a short progress note:
  - `lotar comment <ID> -m "what changed + where"`

## ID + project notes

- IDs look like `PROJ-123`. If you’re in a single-project repo (or have `default_project` set), many commands accept numeric-only IDs.
- When ambiguous, always use the fully-qualified ID or pass `--project`.

## Good “agent” update pattern

- Keep comments short and actionable:
  - What changed (1 sentence)
  - Where (paths/symbols)
  - Next step (1 line)

## Safety

- Don’t paste secrets/PII into task comments (tokens, auth headers, cookies).

generated_query: I'm working on a project called "Auth System Overhaul" and I need to keep track of the tasks I'm doing. Could you help me set up a task for implementing two-factor authentication? It's a high-priority feature. Also, after I start working on it, I'll ask you to mark it as in progress and add a quick note about which files I changed. Right now, just create the task with the title "Implement 2FA via SMS" and set its priority to HIGH and type to feature.

edit_instructions.rationale: Removing the command to create a task with priority and type makes the skill unable to fulfill the user's immediate request to set up a high-priority feature task.
